name: valid figure with animatable parts
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><g id="figure"><g id="leg_l" data-pivot="45,100"><rect x="40" y="100" width="8" height="90" fill="#223"/></g><g id="arm_r" data-pivot="55,60"><rect x="52" y="60" width="6" height="45" fill="#c33"/></g><circle id="head" data-pivot="50,40" cx="50" cy="40" r="12" fill="#eca"/></g></svg>

name: a well-formed data-face is kept and a malformed one is dropped
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><g id="head" data-pivot="50,40" data-face="54,30,12"><circle cx="50" cy="30" r="12" fill="#eca"/></g><g id="torso" data-face="javascript:1"><rect x="40" y="45" width="20" height="50"/></g></svg>

name: script element and its text are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><script>alert(1)</script><rect x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: event handler attributes are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200" onload="steal()"><rect onclick="x()" onmouseover="y()" x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: foreignObject and its html children are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><foreignObject x="0" y="0" width="50" height="50"><iframe src="http://evil.example/"></iframe></foreignObject><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5"/></svg>

name: external image is removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><image href="http://evil.example/x.png" x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5"/></svg>

name: use pointing outside the document is dropped
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><use xlink:href="http://evil.example/a.svg#b"/><use href="data:image/svg+xml,xx"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5"/></svg>

name: use pointing at an internal id is kept
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><defs><circle id="dot" cx="5" cy="5" r="5"/></defs><use href="#dot" x="20" y="20"/></svg>

name: external url() in a paint attribute is dropped
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><rect fill="url(http://evil.example/p.svg#a)" x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: internal gradient reference is kept
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><defs><linearGradient id="grad"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000"/></linearGradient></defs><rect fill="url(#grad)" x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: style element and attribute are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><style>@import url(http://evil.example/x.css); rect {fill:red}</style><rect style="fill:url(http://evil.example)" x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: anchor and javascript links are removed
animation elements are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10"><animate attributeName="x" to="50" dur="1s"/><set attributeName="fill" to="red"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform"/></svg>

name: text elements are removed
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><text x="0" y="10">hello</text><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5"/></svg>

name: doctype with entities is rejected outright
svg: <!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY a "aaaaaaaaaa"><!ENTITY b "&a;&a;&a;&a;">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5"/></svg>

name: a non-svg root is rejected
svg: <html><body><script>alert(1)</script></body></html>

name: malformed xml is rejected
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5">

name: unknown elements are removed but their allowed siblings stay
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><filter id="f"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="50"/></filter><rect x="0" y="0" width="5" height="5" filter="url(#f)"/></svg>

name: css-escaped url() in a paint attribute is dropped
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10" fill="\75 rl(//evil.example/x.svg#g)" stroke="u\72l(#ok)"/><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="2" stop-color="\000075rl(evil)" fill="#fff"/></svg>

name: protocol-relative references are dropped
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 200"><defs><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#000"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="0" y="0" width="10" height="10" fill="url(//evil.example/x.svg#g)" clip-path="//evil.example/c"/><use href="//evil.example/x.svg#g"/><rect x="1" y="1" width="2" height="2" fill="url(#g)"/></svg>
